content: प्रभ्रंश् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> €4 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To fall or drop down, slip; प्रभ्रश्यमानाभरणप्रसूना <ls>R. 14. 54</ls>. .²2 To lose, be deprived of; प्रभ्रश्यते तेजसः <ls>Mk. 1. 14</ls>. .²3 To escape or free onself from. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To throw or bring down from, cause to fall down from; प्रभ्रंशयां यो नहुषं चकार <ls>R. 13. 36</ls>.
